Retail Unit for Sale in Skyhills Residences 3 – Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC)
Presented by Provident Real Estate

Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional retail unit for sale in Skyhills Residences 3, a modern and fast-rising development in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). Perfectly positioned on the ground floor, this retail space offers high visibility and consistent footfall—ideal for investors or entrepreneurs looking to establish a presence in one of Dubai’s most in-demand residential communities.

Property Details:

Type: Retail Unit
Location: Skyhills Residences 3, JVC
Parking: Dedicated Parking Included
Position: Road-facing with direct street access and high visibility

Key Features:

Located on the ground floor of a high-occupancy residential tower
Ideal for cafés, salons, clinics, convenience stores, or boutiques

Surrounded by a rapidly growing residential and commercial community

Strong rental yield potential in a high-demand area

 Minutes from Circle Mall, schools, parks, and essential amenities
